method: Read-only primary documentation retrieval via web tool, not a browser launch/retry or code execution.

records.finding: Dictionary ID denotes a code; calibrated projection, ordered physical corners and marker size support metric pose. The returned rigid mapping goes marker to camera. Axis colours and physical scale are documented.
Camera projection uses intrinsic parameters and per-view object-to-camera extrinsics. This does not supply a robot-frame registration.
Ordinary encoded HSV hue is 0–179 and conversion flags must match actual BGR/RGB channel order.
Opening is erosion then dilation; closing reverses this order and depends on the kernel.
Centroid uses first moments divided by nonzero area moment.
Maintainer identifies this repository as the Python port of the OpenShowVar/KukaVarProxy client.
Maintainer describes a request-response Cross3 server and KukaVarProxy-compatible protocol; this is not evidence of a hard timing bound.
